datasets.name: card_kpis
queryLines: select balance_owed, net_spending, payments, fees_and_interest, cast(oldest_account_as_of as string) as oldest_account_as_of, cast(latest_account_as_of as string) as latest_account_as_of from __CATALOG__.gold.card_kpis

datasets.name: card_balances
queryLines: select account_id, cast(period_from as string) as period_from, cast(period_to as string) as period_to, opening_balance, balance_owed, charges, payments_and_credits from __CATALOG__.gold.card_statement_balances order by period_to desc

datasets.name: card_spend
queryLines: select * from __CATALOG__.gold.card_spend_by_category order by amount desc

datasets.name: card_activity
queryLines: select txn_date, cast(txn_date as string) as day, account_id, counterparty_clean, activity_type, category, amount, spending_amount, debt_change from __CATALOG__.gold.card_activity order by txn_date desc, seq desc

datasets.name: card_status
queryLines: select file, cast(period_to as string) as period_to, cast(reconciled as string) as reconciled, txn_count, errors from __CATALOG__.gold.statement_status order by file

datasets.name: card_copies
queryLines: select file_sha256, count(distinct object_key) as copies from __CATALOG__.bronze.statement_files group by file_sha256 having count(distinct object_key) > 1

datasets.name: card_review
queryLines: select account_id, currency, category, counterparty_clean, direction, txns, total, reason from __CATALOG__.gold.review_queue order by total desc

widget.name: card_intro
widget.textbox_spec:
# __COMPANY__ Credit Cards
USD statement balances owed and transaction activity. Payments reduce debt; refunds offset spending. Figures cover the loaded statements, not a live card balance.

widget.name: card_spend_intro
widget.textbox_spec:
# Spending in USD
Purchases, fees and interest less refunds. Payments, advances and explicitly identified balance transfers are excluded. Review other charges and unclassified merchants.

widget.name: card_activity_intro
widget.textbox_spec:
# Transactions
Filter by transaction date. A positive debt change increases the amount owed. Statement dates and posting dates can differ from transaction dates.

widget.name: card_quality_intro
widget.textbox_spec:
# Data quality
Each loaded statement passed section totals and balance reconciliation. Failed statements remain quarantined. Duplicate PDFs and duplicate transaction appearances are shown separately.
